senses.gloss:
अट् अट्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 1586), To roam, with the loc. and acc. MBh. 1, 1031; Daśak. in Chr. 179, 6.
 --With the preposition परि परि, To wander about, Pañc. 55, 1.
 पुर्यटित, n. Wandering about, Pañc. 70, 12.

† अट्ट् अट्ट्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To transgress.
 2. To kill.
 --i. 10, Par. To slight.
